content.short: Decentralized exchange and finance platform dedicated to the tokenized gaming industry.
content.description: At its heart, Thothus is a decentralized exchange and finance platform dedicated to the tokenized gaming industry. The platform will be a home for gamers to swap their game tokens, stake their game tokens, auction their non-fungible tokens (NFT), monetize their game experience, and find important information about currently available games with their respective play to earn ranking.
